g.text: Task rewards and the traces that reached training
Synchronous PPO · job 196 · 2 optimizer updates · 32 accepted training traces
Unscored attempts excluded from the scored-attempt mean, by update: [0, 0]. Accepted rewards are never group-centered here.
The IPO run filters zero-credit groups; PPO retains them. Admission differences prevent an apples-to-apples quality ranking.
Source: recorded training.log + rollout JSON; compact data and input hashes in ../../metrics/rl-metrics.json.
Training-batch diagnostics only. These short runs do not establish convergence or held-out quality.
